note: The mood faces (decisions 149/150; the approved screen review): each mood 1-5 is a circle in its Sunrise colour (colour-map.json steps) with this glyph centred on it. The glyph is drawn in a 24 x 24 box scaled to glyph_scale of the circle's diameter. Eyes are filled dots; mouths are stroked SVG paths (round caps and joins). The ink is the same in both themes, since every Sunrise colour is light. The circle keeps its 1 px muted outline (colour-map.json outline); a selected face adds the accent ring (colour-roles §3). The app and the web draw from this file and test against it.
